messages.subject: Version Change? Custom Input Control - Chooser Function.
parts:
Yesterday I updated to R 3.2 and corresponding packages. Now, for some reason the Custom Input Control illustrating the chooser function on shiny no longer has the correct layout. Specifically, the starting point of the empty UI container is collapsed and the direction arrows are no longer at the mid-point of the containers. The empty container resizes when text is transferred.

I'm getting this issue when I run the example code myself and on the RStudio widget example page.  I've included a link to the widget below and attached screen shots illustrating my experience.

Any idea what's happening here? Is this a CSS issue?

http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/custom-input-control.html


Thanks!
